nodes.name: client.py
nodes.summary: HTTP client wrapping the FPT FLM curriculum portal: authenticates via cookie, and exposes search/lookup methods for subjects, syllabi, curricula, combos, electives, and prerequisites.
nodes.languageNotes: Detects login redirects and login-page markers in responses to raise FlmAuthError, since the portal returns HTTP 200 even when the session cookie is invalid.

nodes.name: FlmClient
nodes.summary: Session-based client for the FPT FLM portal providing methods to search subjects, fetch syllabus/curriculum/combo/elective details, and check prerequisites, with auth-failure detection.

nodes.name: flm_to_coverage.py
nodes.summary: CLI/library module that matches FLM syllabus learning outcomes to a skill catalog (via LLM or keyword matching) and builds curriculum coverage and overlay reports.
nodes.languageNotes: Falls back from LLM-based semantic matching to simple keyword matching when the LLM service is disabled, keeping the pipeline usable offline.

nodes.name: load_catalog
nodes.summary: Loads and normalizes the skill catalog CSV into a list of skill records used for coverage matching.

nodes.name: _match_llm
nodes.summary: Uses the LLM completion service to match a course-learning-outcome text against catalog skill names, returning matched and extra skill names.

nodes.name: is_major_subject
nodes.summary: Determines whether a subject code belongs to the major curriculum (as opposed to general/elective placeholders) via a regex prefix check.

nodes.name: build_coverage
nodes.summary: Builds the per-subject skill coverage report by matching each subject's learning outcomes against the catalog, tracking prerequisites and unmatched skills.

nodes.name: curriculum_from_soup
nodes.summary: Parses a curriculum HTML page into a structured list of major-subject entries with term, credits, and prerequisite metadata.

nodes.name: build_overlay
nodes.summary: Merges FLM syllabus data, computed coverage, and curriculum term/credit info into a combined overlay structure grouped by term.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that parses arguments, loads FLM/catalog/curriculum data, and writes coverage and overlay JSON output files.

nodes.name: scraper.py
nodes.summary: CLI tool for interactively scraping the FLM portal: subject codes, syllabi, curricula, combos, electives, and prerequisites, with a full crawl command.

nodes.name: scrape_syllabus
nodes.summary: Searches for and parses all syllabus versions for a subject code, returning structured syllabus metadata, CLOs, materials, and sessions.

nodes.name: _merge_group
nodes.summary: Merges combo/elective subject groups into the curriculum mapping, tracking which combos or electives each subject can satisfy.

nodes.name: discover_curriculum
nodes.summary: Discovers the full curriculum structure for a curriculum id, including trunk subjects plus combo and elective group subjects.

nodes.name: cmd_crawl
nodes.summary: CLI subcommand that crawls a full curriculum, scraping syllabi and prerequisites for each subject code and writing combined output to a JSON file.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that builds the argument parser with subcommands (codes, syllabus, curricula, curriculum, prereq, crawl) and dispatches to the FlmClient.

nodes.name: sync_job.py
nodes.summary: In-memory background job manager that runs the FLM discovery/coverage/overlay pipeline on a worker thread and tracks job status by id.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an in-process dict plus a daemon thread for job tracking rather than a task queue, so job state does not survive process restarts.

nodes.name: start_job
nodes.summary: Creates a new job id, registers it as running, and launches the sync pipeline on a background daemon thread.

nodes.name: _discover_codes
nodes.summary: Resolves the set of subject codes to sync, either from the curriculum id or from comma-separated subject-code prefixes.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Worker function executed on a background thread that authenticates, discovers subject codes, scrapes syllabi and prerequisites, then builds coverage and overlay results while updating job progress.

nodes.name: itviec_parser.py
nodes.summary: Scrapes and parses ITviec job listings via JSON-LD structured data, extracting salary, experience, and location fields, and persists companies/recruitments/posts to the database.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on the site's embedded JSON-LD schema.org JobPosting data rather than HTML scraping for most structured fields.

nodes.name: _json_ld
nodes.summary: Extracts and parses JSON-LD script blocks from a page matching a desired schema.org @type.

nodes.name: _job_url_list
nodes.summary: Extracts the list of job posting URLs from a search results page's JSON-LD ItemList.

nodes.name: _parse_salary
nodes.summary: Normalizes a JSON-LD baseSalary object into a human-readable salary string.

nodes.name: _parse_experience
nodes.summary: Converts JSON-LD experienceRequirements (ISO 8601 duration or dict) into a human-readable years-of-experience string.

nodes.name: _parse_location
nodes.summary: Normalizes a JSON-LD jobLocation object (single or list of addresses) into a comma-joined location string.

nodes.name: scrape_itviec_detail
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses a single ITviec job detail page into a structured recruitment record including company, salary, location, and skills.

nodes.name: parse_itviec_jobs
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the ITviec scrape: paginates search results, fetches job details up to a limit, then upserts companies, recruitments, and recruitment posts into the database.

nodes.name: linkedin_parser.py
nodes.summary: Selenium-based scraper stub that opens LinkedIn job search results in headless Chrome and logs the discovered job card elements.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Selenium/headless Chrome instead of curl-based scraping, likely because LinkedIn requires JS rendering or stronger anti-bot evasion.

nodes.name: parse_linkedin_jobs
nodes.summary: Launches a headless Chrome browser to load LinkedIn job search results and logs the number of job cards found.

nodes.name: topcv_parser.py
nodes.summary: Scrapes and parses TopCV company and recruitment detail pages via CSS selectors, normalizing Vietnamese field labels, and persists results to the database.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes a Vietnamese-to-English label mapping (convert_to_eng) to normalize TopCV's localized field names into canonical keys.

nodes.name: convert_to_eng
nodes.summary: Maps Vietnamese TopCV field labels to normalized English snake_case keys using a lookup table with a regex fallback.

nodes.name: get_descriptions
nodes.summary:
Recursively extracts text lines from nested TopCV description list items, handling
tags as line breaks.

nodes.name: scrape_company_detail
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses a TopCV company detail page into a structured company record with name, description, industry, size, and address.

nodes.name: scrape_recruitment_detail
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses a TopCV job posting detail page into a structured recruitment record including salary, experience, deadline, description, and requirements.

nodes.name: parse_topcv_jobs
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the TopCV scrape: paginates search results, fetches company and recruitment details up to a limit, then upserts records into the database.

nodes.name: processor.py
nodes.summary: Post-processing pipeline that summarizes and structures unprocessed scraped companies and recruitments via the LLM service and stores the results as ProcessedCompany/ProcessedRecruitment records.

nodes.name: process_unprocessed_data
nodes.summary: Finds companies and recruitments without a processed counterpart, summarizes each via the LLM into structured JSON, and persists new ProcessedCompany/ProcessedRecruitment rows.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker file for the `services` package.

nodes.name: llm_service.py
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper around an OpenAI-compatible chat completion client providing text/JSON completion helpers and skill extraction from job descriptions.

nodes.name: is_enabled
nodes.summary: Returns whether the LLM service is configured (an API key is present), used by callers to gate LLM-based features.

nodes.name: _get_client
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and caches an OpenAI-compatible client using the configured API key and base URL.

nodes.name: complete_text
nodes.summary: Sends a system/user prompt pair to the configured chat model and returns the completion text, logging errors on failure.

nodes.name: complete_json
nodes.summary: Wraps complete_text and parses the response as JSON, returning an empty dict on parse failure.

nodes.name: extract_skills
nodes.summary: Uses the LLM to extract a deduplicated list of skill names from a free-text job description.

nodes.name: markitdown_service.py
nodes.summary: Downloads a document from a public URL (with SSRF protection against private/loopback IPs) and converts it to markdown using the markitdown library.
nodes.languageNotes: validate_public_document_url resolves the hostname and rejects private/loopback/link-local addresses to mitigate server-side request forgery (SSRF).

nodes.name: validate_public_document_url
nodes.summary: Validates that a URL uses http(s) and resolves to a public (non-private, non-loopback) IP address, raising ValueError otherwise.

nodes.name: extract_markdown_from_url
nodes.summary: Downloads the document at a validated URL to a temp file, converts it to markdown via markitdown, and cleans up the temp file.

nodes.name: test_flm_curriculum.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for flm_to_coverage's major-subject filtering, curriculum-from-soup parsing, and combo label parsing logic.

nodes.name: TestIsMajorSubject
nodes.summary: Tests that is_major_subject correctly keeps engineering/maths/capstone subjects and drops out-of-major, combo, and elective placeholder codes.

nodes.name: TestCurriculumFromSoup
nodes.summary: Tests that curriculum_from_soup keeps only major subjects and correctly carries term, credit, and combo metadata.

nodes.name: TestComboParsing
nodes.summary: Tests combo label parsing: reading combo labels, splitting code from name, and handling labels without a colon.

nodes.name: test_flm_parsers.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for FLM syllabus HTML parsing helpers: session/download-link parsing, CLO extraction, and syllabus version ranking.

nodes.name: TestParseSessions
nodes.summary: Tests parse_sessions' handling of relative/absolute download hrefs, missing downloads, and multi-row session tables.

nodes.name: TestFindSyllabusLinks
nodes.summary: Tests find_syllabus_links' version ranking logic, ensuring current versions rank first and decision-date ties are broken correctly.

nodes.name: TestDownloadLinkHygiene
nodes.summary: Tests edge cases in download-link extraction: distinguishing page links from file links and handling multi-link hrefs.
